description: K2b (fix/aromaticity-flag-demotion-k2b) required deep diagnosis of the 84-molecule/499-atom-flag regression that build_molecule_from_model's authoritative-demotion fix surfaces on the 5000-molecule corpus's 'kekulized' calling convention (Kekulize-first, then apply_aromaticity). Base for this analysis: fix/aromaticity-charge-aware-pi-electrons-k2a (i.e. K2a's charge fix is ALREADY applied and does not touch any of these 84). Raw data: aromaticity_flag_demotion_k2b_cluster_dump.jsonl (per-molecule SSSR/augmented-ring-set/Pass1-trace/ring-classification/final-flags dump, via crates/chematic-perception/examples/aromaticity_flag_demotion_k2b_cluster_dump.rs) and aromaticity_flag_demotion_k2b_changed_smiles.txt (the 84 SMILES). NOT FIXED in this PR -- diagnosis only, per explicit instruction (no molecule-specific allowlist, no fallback that unconditionally trusts input flags).

azulene_type_nonalternant.mechanism: Two ortho-fused rings each independently get an ODD Pass-1 pi-electron count (every ring atom contributes 1pi via an endo- or exocyclic-to-a-carbon double bond, so an odd-membered evaluation set is structurally guaranteed to sum odd). Neither ring reaches Aromatic (4n+2) OR Antiaromatic (4n) classification, so mark_ring_aromatic never fires for either, and Pass 2's propagation never seeds (seeding requires an ALREADY-confirmed adjacent ring). This is the SAME, already-documented gap as azulene itself (docs/aromaticity_a1_rfc.md, the existing #[ignore = "PROVISIONAL"] test_azulene_kekulized_aromatic) -- K2b's demotion fix does not introduce a new bug here, it makes this PRE-EXISTING gap visible for the first time on these 49 additional molecules (previously masked by the promote-only bug: the stale parser flag happened to coincidentally match RDKit).
azulene_type_nonalternant.minimal_repro_note: This IS azulene itself -- already the canonical minimal example in this codebase, re-verified live against rdkit==2026.03.3 rather than assumed. RDKit: all 10 atoms aromatic, 9/10 bonds aromatic (the SMILES's own explicit '-2' fusion bond stays a formal single bond in RDKit's own answer too). chematic: 0/10 atoms, ring_classifications = [NonAromatic pi=5 (5-ring), NonAromatic pi=7 (7-ring)]. Pinned as a regression test: test_known_gap_azulene_nonalternant_odd_odd_split.
azulene_type_nonalternant.note_on_pattern: Most cluster members share azulene's own SMILES convention of an explicit single-bond ring-fusion marker (e.g. '-2', '-4') on a non-alternant 5-7 or 5-6 fused heteroaromatic core, frequently with an [nH] or ring-N somewhere in the system -- but the ROOT CAUSE is the odd/odd Pass-1 electron split, not the presence of [nH] or a bridgehead N per se. An explicit search across all 84 for a genuinely distinct 'bridgehead-N/indolizine-shaped' mechanism (a fusion-atom N with reason NitrogenBridgeheadOrSubstitutedLonePair) found NONE where that was the sole driving cause independent of this odd/odd split or the large-polycyclic cluster below -- see next section.

fused_diazine_quinazoline_quinoxaline_pu.mechanism: In an ortho-fused bicyclic (or larger) aromatic system where the shared fusion bond itself is SINGLE in chematic_core::kekulize()'s chosen Kekule structure, each of the two fusion atoms carries its own individual double bond pointing to one of its OTHER ring neighbors -- which, for one fusion atom, lies in ring A, and for the other, lies in ring B. When ring A is evaluated (Pass 1, single-ring, no cross-ring context), a fusion atom whose OWN double bond points into ring B is, by definition, 'exocyclic to ring A' from that isolated evaluation's point of view. If that exocyclic partner happens to be a heteroatom (N/O/S) -- true whenever the OTHER ring's own N sits adjacent to that specific fusion atom, exactly the quinazoline/quinoxaline/naphthyridine/purine shape -- ring_pi_electrons' CarbonExocyclicHeteroatomDouble rule (designed for genuine substituents like tropone's C=O) misfires, zeroing that fusion atom's contribution. If ONLY ONE of the two fusion atoms suffers this, the ring's Pass-1 total lands on an ODD number (NonAromatic, which Pass 2 IS allowed to retry -- and Pass 2's own aromatic_context mechanism, via the pre-existing 'AlreadyAromaticContext' 1pi shortcut, correctly bypasses the misfire and fixes the ring). If BOTH fusion atoms suffer it simultaneously (both zeroed), the ring's Pass-1 total can land on EXACTLY 4 (Antiaromatic, 4n) -- and Antiaromatic is treated as a DEFINITIVE classification the Pass 1 loop explicitly never retries in Pass 2 (assign_aromaticity_ex's own comment: 'Antiaromatic is definitive -- do not retry'), even though the exact same aromatic_context mechanism that fixes the one-fusion-atom case would ALSO fix this one if only given the chance. Confirmed Kekule-choice-dependent (not shape-dependent alone): plain, unsubstituted quinoxaline (c1ccc2nccnc2c1) and quinazoline (c1ccc2ncncc2c1) do NOT reproduce this (kekulize() happens to choose a structure where only one fusion atom is affected, landing on the retryable odd case) -- it is specifically which Kekule structure kekulize() picks (itself sensitive to exact N placement, and in the corpus set, correlated with an N-substituent elsewhere in the molecule) that determines whether a given quinazoline/quinoxaline/purine-shaped molecule falls into this trap.
fused_diazine_quinazoline_quinoxaline_pu.minimal_repro_note: A bare, unsubstituted naphthyridine isomer, 15 characters, not itself one of the 84 (constructed specifically as a minimal, substituent-free repro of the dominant pattern). RDKit: fully aromatic, all 10 atoms/10 bonds (verified live). chematic: model_aromatic_atom_count=6 (only the pyridine-type ring); the benzo ring [atoms 4,5,6,7 unique + 3,8 fusion] gets Pass-1 classification Antiaromatic, pi_count=4 -- atoms 3 and 8 (the two fusion carbons) both score CarbonExocyclicHeteroatomDouble (0pi) instead of CarbonEndocyclicDouble (1pi), because their individual Kekule double bonds point to the OTHER ring's two nitrogens (atoms 2 and 9). Pinned as a regression test: test_known_gap_fused_diazine_exocyclic_misfire_antiaromatic.
fused_diazine_quinazoline_quinoxaline_pu.exact_divergence_point: ring_pi_electrons' carbon branch, the CarbonExocyclicHeteroatomDouble condition (crates/chematic-perception/src/aromaticity.rs) -- it checks whether a double-bond partner is 'not in THIS ring's atom set' as its sole signal for 'genuinely exocyclic substituent', with no check for whether that partner is itself part of a DIFFERENT ring that ends up aromatic (a ring-fusion bond, not a substituent).

large_polycyclic_sssr_special_case.mechanism: Not deeply decomposed (genuinely a special case, per its own name) -- these are two large, densely-fused polycyclic cage-shaped molecules (82 and 73 heavy atoms, 32 SSSR rings each, augmented_ring_set identical to raw SSSR so ring augmentation is not itself a factor here) that are structurally unlike anything else in the drug-like corpus (they read as an oxazole/benzofuran-fused macrolactam natural-product-like scaffold, not a simple aromatic heterocycle). chematic confirms 44/82 and 44/73 atoms aromatic respectively (12 rings classified Aromatic, 6 NonAromatic, out of 18 total SSSR rings -- the remaining ~14 rings are saturated substituent/macrocycle rings unrelated to the aromatic system and correctly return no classification at all). Whether the 6 NonAromatic rings share either of the two mechanisms above, a third mechanism, or several compounding factors across this much larger, more complex fused system was not established -- this bucket is reported honestly as unresolved rather than force-fit into one of the other two clusters.
large_polycyclic_sssr_special_case.minimal_repro_note: No smaller synthetic repro was constructed given the molecule's inherent complexity and the time budget for this diagnosis; the two corpus molecules themselves are the only available examples. Flagged as future work, not fixed or further isolated here.

nh_fused_azaindole_indolizine.mechanism: EMPTY as an independently-distinct cluster in this 84-molecule set -- explicitly verified, not merely absent by omission. Searched all 84 for a genuine ring-FUSION atom (member of 2+ SSSR rings) carrying ContributionReason::NitrogenBridgeheadOrSubstitutedLonePair (the bridgehead-N rule, e.g. indolizine's junction N) or NitrogenPyrroleTypeH acting as a fusion atom: the only hits were inside the 2 large-polycyclic molecules above (already counted there). Every superficially azaindole/indolizine-shaped case among the 84 (an [nH] in one ring fused to a plain-N or plain-C ring) reduces, on inspection of its actual ring_classifications, to the SAME azulene-type odd/odd Pass-1 split described above -- e.g. one candidate constructed while searching for a repro (c2cc3ccc[nH]c3n2) showed its 5-ring landing on NonAromatic pi=5 for the ordinary odd-split reason, not a bridgehead-specific one. Reported as a confirmed-empty cluster rather than silently dropping the coordinator's requested bucket name.

coverage_check: 49 + 33 + 2 + 0 = 84, matches the full changed-molecule count exactly; 0 molecules fell into an unclassified 'other' bucket.
hard_rule_compliance: No molecule-specific allowlist, SMILES-based exception list, or flag-trusting fallback was added anywhere in this diagnosis or in K2a/K2b's production code. The two minimal repros above are pinned as FAILING regression tests (test_known_gap_fused_diazine_exocyclic_misfire_antiaromatic, test_known_gap_azulene_nonalternant_odd_odd_split in crates/chematic-perception/src/aromaticity.rs) that assert the CURRENT (still-wrong) chematic output, not a patch that changes it.
not_done: No fix was attempted for either mechanism (both require a genuine model change -- e.g. distinguishing ring-fusion double bonds from real exocyclic substituents in the CarbonExocyclicHeteroatomDouble rule, and/or a non-alternant whole-perimeter Huckel candidate for azulene-shaped systems -- explicitly out of scope for this diagnosis-only round per the coordinator's instructions).
The 2-molecule large-polycyclic cluster's root cause(s) were not isolated further.
Descriptor/ECFP4/canonical-SMILES re-measurement (required before K2b's eventual merge, not for this diagnosis round) was not run.
